speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it? Have you noticed any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea accompanying the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze that radiates down to my left arm. It started suddenly an hour ago and hasn't gotten any better with rest; I'm also feeling quite short of breath and a bit nauseous. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). Please call emergency services immediately; do not wait for further questions.
